sequential_dependency.intermediate: The central segment's exact occupied template and each segment's symmetric-difference adjustment to its translated target.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Order all parallel segments by lane and translate the complete spatially central segment onto every lane.

sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: The winner is not the longest or shortest raw segment in general; it depends on the exact translated central template produced by stage A.
